28136: function installPoems(){

28146:     return p;
28147:   }
28148:   function tick(){

28150:     var ph=POEMS[idx%POEMS.length]; idx++;
28151:     var loc=ph[getLang()]||ph.en;
28152:     p.innerHTML=(loc===ph.en)?ph.en:(ph.en+'<br>'+loc);
28153:   }
28154:   function stopIfHidden(){
28155:     setTimeout(function(){
28156:       var o=document.querySelector('.cfWaitOverlay');
28157:       if((!o || !o.classList.contains('show')) && timer){ clearInterval(timer); timer=null; }
28158:     },80);
28159:   }
28160:   var _show=w.show, _hide=w.hide, _hideAll=w.hideAll;
28161:   w.show=function(msg,delay){
28162:     _show(msg,delay);
28163:     if(!timer){ idx=0; tick(); timer=setInterval(tick,3400); }
28164:   };
28165:   w.hide=function(){ _hide(); stopIfHidden(); };
28166:   w.hideAll=function(){ _hideAll(); stopIfHidden(); };
28167: }
28168:

20649:     // Generation may never wait for analysis. Category and upload controls are the safe default.
20650:     if(typeof src.intraoral!=='boolean') src.intraoral=((src.category||'').toLowerCase()==='intraoral');
20651:     if(typeof src.intraoralDark!=='boolean') src.intraoralDark=false;

20655:   // Produce the after-image: photoreal AI backend when enabled+configured, else the local
20656:   // artifact-free colour/finish pass.
20657:   const CF_PRIMARY_RESULT_DEADLINE_MS=18000;
20658:   const CF_PRIMARY_PREFLIGHT_MS=700;
20659:   async function cfFastPrimaryPreview(src,raw){
20660:     if(!src||!src.dataUrl) return null;
20661:     try{
20662:       const img=await Promise.race([
20663:         loadImage(src.dataUrl),
20664:         new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('quick preview decode timeout')),1800))
20665:       ]);
20666:       const iw=img.naturalWidth||img.width,ih=img.naturalHeight||img.height;
20667:       if(!iw||!ih) return src.dataUrl;
20668:       const maxEdge=960,scale=Math.min(1,maxEdge/Math.max(iw,ih));
20669:       const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(iw*scale)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(ih*scale));
20670:       const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
20671:       const x=c.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});x.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;x.imageSmoothingQuality='high';x.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
20672:       // A deliberately conservative, GPU-light optical preview. It never claims structural AI accuracy.
20673:       const facial=((src.category||'').toLowerCase()==='facial')||(!src.intraoral&&src.lips!==false);
20674:       const rx=facial?w*.31:w*.12, ry=facial?h*.50:h*.18, rw=facial?w*.38:w*.76, rh=facial?h*.23:h*.55;
20675:       const tmp=document.createElement('canvas');tmp.width=w;tmp.height=h;
20676:       const tx=tmp.getContext('2d');
20677:       const shade=((raw&&raw.shade)!=null?raw.shade:50); const bright=1+Math.max(0,shade-50)/50*.07;
20678:       tx.filter='brightness('+bright.toFixed(3)+') saturate(.92) contrast(1.025)';tx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);tx.filter='none';
20679:       x.save();x.beginPath();x.ellipse(rx+rw/2,ry+rh/2,rw/2,rh/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);x.clip();x.globalAlpha=.74;x.drawImage(tmp,0,0);x.restore();
20680:       try{drawBadge(x,w,h);}catch(e){}
20681:       const out=c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.82);c.width=c.height=1;tmp.width=tmp.height=1;return out;
20682:     }catch(e){ console.warn('[CaseFlow] quick preview fallback uses source',e); return src.dataUrl; }
20683:   }
20684:   window.cfFastPrimaryPreview=cfFastPrimaryPreview;
20685:   async function produceImage(src){
20686:     const started=performance.now();
20687:     let progressTimer=null, deadlineTimer=null;
20688:     window.__caseflowQuickPreviewUsed=false;
20689:     try{sessionStorage.setItem('cf_primary_generation_guard_v3',JSON.stringify({startedAt:Date.now()}));}catch(e){}
20690:     try{if(window.cfWait)cfWait.show('AIシミュレーション中',0);}catch(e){}
20691:     const quickTask=cfFastPrimaryPreview(src,state.simV96||{});
20692:     try{
20693:       await Promise.allSettled([
20694:         Promise.race([ensureIntraoralFlag(src),new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,CF_PRIMARY_PREFLIGHT_MS))]),
20695:         Promise.race([ensureProblemList(src),new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,CF_PRIMARY_PREFLIGHT_MS))])
20696:       ]);
20697:     }catch(e){}
20698:     const preflightMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);
20699:     const aiOn=aiEnabled();
20700:     if(aiOn){
20701:       const msgs=['画像を最適化中…','AIシミュレーション生成中…','臨床デザインを確認中…'];let mi=0;
20702:       const tick=()=>{try{const q=document.querySelector('.cfWaitOverlay .cfWaitSub');if(q)q.textContent=msgs[mi++%msgs.length];}catch(e){}};
20703:       tick();progressTimer=setInterval(tick,2200);
20704:     }
20705:     try{
20706:       if(aiOn){
20707:         const aiTask=generateViaAI(src).then(url=>({kind:'ai',url})).catch(err=>({kind:'error',err}));
20708:         const remaining=Math.max(2500,CF_PRIMARY_RESULT_DEADLINE_MS-(performance.now()-started));
20709:         const deadlineTask=new Promise(resolve=>{deadlineTimer=setTimeout(()=>resolve({kind:'deadline'}),remaining);});
20710:         const result=await Promise.race([aiTask,deadlineTask]);
20711:         if(result&&result.kind==='ai'&&result.url){
20712:           window.__caseflowPrimaryResultMode='ai';return result.url;
20713:         }
20714:         if(result&&result.kind==='error'&&result.err&&result.err.cfNoTokens) throw result.err;
20715:         if(result&&result.kind==='deadline'){try{if(window.__cfGenerationAbort)window.__cfGenerationAbort();}catch(e){}}
20716:         if(result&&result.kind==='error') window.__caseflowLastAIError=String((result.err&&result.err.message)||result.err||'AI error');
20717:       }
20718:       // Absolute contract: always resolve the first result screen without invoking the heavy
20719:       // full-frame local pixel/MediaPipe fallback after an AI stall.
20720:       let quick=null;
20721:       try{quick=await Promise.race([quickTask,new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(()=>resolve(src&&src.dataUrl||null),1200))]);}catch(e){quick=src&&src.dataUrl||null;}
20722:       if(!quick) throw new Error('一次プレビューを作成できませんでした');
20723:       window.__caseflowQuickPreviewUsed=true;window.__caseflowPrimaryResultMode='quick';
20724:       setTimeout(()=>{try{toastFn('通信が時間内に完了しなかったため、軽量プレビューを表示しました。精密生成は結果画面から再実行できます。');}catch(e){}},80);
20725:       return quick;
20726:     } finally {
20727:       clearInterval(progressTimer);clearTimeout(deadlineTimer);
20728:       const totalMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);
20729:       window.__caseflowGenerationTiming={preflight_ms:preflightMs,total_ms:totalMs,mode:window.__caseflowPrimaryResultMode||'unknown',hard_deadline_ms:CF_PRIMARY_RESULT_DEADLINE_MS,completed_at:new Date().toISOString()};
20730:       try{if(typeof window.cfLogEvent==='function')window.cfLogEvent('generation_timing','visual-simulation',window.__caseflowGenerationTiming);}catch(e){}
20731:       try{sessionStorage.removeItem('cf_primary_generation_guard_v3');}catch(e){}
20732:       try{if(window.cfWait)cfWait.hideAll();}catch(e){}
20733:     }
20734:   }

20737:   async function regenerate(){
20738:     if(regenBusy){ regenQueued=true; return; }
20739:     const src=state._simSource||pickSource();
20740:     if(!src) return;
20741:     regenBusy=true; setBusy(true);

20745:       // stay intact), so re-editing never makes a previously generated image disappear.
20746:       const r=Object.assign({}, state.simResult, {

20751:       else { state.simResults=[r]; state.simResultIndex=0; }

20757:     }catch(e){ console.error(e); toastFn('再生成に失敗しました'); }
20758:     regenBusy=false; setBusy(false);
20759:     if(regenQueued){ regenQueued=false; regenerate(); }
20760:   }

21631: <script>
21632: /* Bulletproof Share-link handler.
21633:    Defined unconditionally here so it never depends on window.state being
21634:    ready (the earlier definition lived inside an IIFE that early-returns
21635:    when window.state is not yet set at parse time, leaving the Share button
21636:    wired to an undefined function). This standalone copy always wins. */
21637: window.cfOpenTopPage = function(){
21638:   var url = location.origin + location.pathname;
21639:   function toastMsg(m){ try{ if(typeof window.toast==='function'){ window.toast(m); return; } }catch(e){} }
21640:   function copyFallback(){
21641:     try{
21642:       var ta=document.createElement('textarea');
21643:       ta.value=url; ta.setAttribute('readonly','');
21644:       ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:-9999px;left:-9999px';
21645:       document.body.appendChild(ta);
21646:       ta.select(); ta.setSelectionRange(0, url.length);
21647:       var ok=false; try{ ok=document.execCommand('copy'); }catch(e){}
21648:       document.body.removeChild(ta);
21649:       if(ok){ toastMsg('リンクをコピーしました'); return; }
21650:     }catch(e){}
21651:     window.prompt('このリンクをコピーしてください', url);
21652:   }
21653:   if(navigator.share){
21654:     try{
21655:       navigator.share({title:'CASEFLOW STUDIO', text:'CASEFLOW STUDIO', url:url})
21656:         .catch(function(e){ if(e && e.name==='AbortError') return; copyFallback(); });
21657:       return;
21658:     }catch(e){ /* fall through to copy */ }
21659:   }
21660:   if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
21661:     navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function(){ toastMsg('リンクをコピーしました'); }, copyFallback);
21662:     return;
21663:   }
21664:   copyFallback();
21665: };

21631: <script>
21632: /* Bulletproof Share-link handler.
21633:    Defined unconditionally here so it never depends on window.state being
21634:    ready (the earlier definition lived inside an IIFE that early-returns
21635:    when window.state is not yet set at parse time, leaving the Share button
21636:    wired to an undefined function). This standalone copy always wins. */
21637: window.cfOpenTopPage = function(){
21638:   var url = location.origin + location.pathname;
21639:   function toastMsg(m){ try{ if(typeof window.toast==='function'){ window.toast(m); return; } }catch(e){} }
21640:   function copyFallback(){
21641:     try{
21642:       var ta=document.createElement('textarea');
21643:       ta.value=url; ta.setAttribute('readonly','');
21644:       ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:-9999px;left:-9999px';
21645:       document.body.appendChild(ta);
21646:       ta.select(); ta.setSelectionRange(0, url.length);
21647:       var ok=false; try{ ok=document.execCommand('copy'); }catch(e){}
21648:       document.body.removeChild(ta);
21649:       if(ok){ toastMsg('リンクをコピーしました'); return; }
21650:     }catch(e){}
21651:     window.prompt('このリンクをコピーしてください', url);
21652:   }
21653:   if(navigator.share){
21654:     try{
21655:       navigator.share({title:'CASEFLOW STUDIO', text:'CASEFLOW STUDIO', url:url})
21656:         .catch(function(e){ if(e && e.name==='AbortError') return; copyFallback(); });
21657:       return;
21658:     }catch(e){ /* fall through to copy */ }
21659:   }
21660:   if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
21661:     navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function(){ toastMsg('リンクをコピーしました'); }, copyFallback);
21662:     return;
21663:   }
21664:   copyFallback();
21665: };
21666: window.shareAppLink = window.cfOpenTopPage;
21667: </script>

21868:   /* Compress a data URL to a small 180px thumbnail (async callback).
21869:      Full-res images in savedSims were filling all of localStorage quota and
21870:      preventing cfPersistLib from writing Library records. */
21871:   function _shrinkSim(url, cb){
21872:     if(!url||!url.startsWith('data:image')){ cb(''); return; }
21873:     var img=new Image();
21874:     img.onload=function(){
21875:       var S=180,s=Math.min(1,S/Math.max(img.naturalWidth||1,img.naturalHeight||1));
21876:       var w=Math.max(1,Math.round((img.naturalWidth||1)*s));
21877:       var h=Math.max(1,Math.round((img.naturalHeight||1)*s));
21878:       var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
21879:       try{c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.72));}
21880:       catch(e){cb('');}
21881:     };
21882:     img.onerror=function(){cb('');};
21883:     img.src=url;
21884:   }

21868:   /* Compress a data URL to a small 180px thumbnail (async callback).
21869:      Full-res images in savedSims were filling all of localStorage quota and
21870:      preventing cfPersistLib from writing Library records. */
21871:   function _shrinkSim(url, cb){
21872:     if(!url||!url.startsWith('data:image')){ cb(''); return; }
21873:     var img=new Image();
21874:     img.onload=function(){
21875:       var S=180,s=Math.min(1,S/Math.max(img.naturalWidth||1,img.naturalHeight||1));
21876:       var w=Math.max(1,Math.round((img.naturalWidth||1)*s));
21877:       var h=Math.max(1,Math.round((img.naturalHeight||1)*s));
21878:       var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
21879:       try{c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.72));}
21880:       catch(e){cb('');}

21869:      Full-res images in savedSims were filling all of localStorage quota and
21870:      preventing cfPersistLib from writing Library records. */
21871:   function _shrinkSim(url, cb){
21872:     if(!url||!url.startsWith('data:image')){ cb(''); return; }
21873:     var img=new Image();
21874:     img.onload=function(){
21875:       var S=180,s=Math.min(1,S/Math.max(img.naturalWidth||1,img.naturalHeight||1));
21876:       var w=Math.max(1,Math.round((img.naturalWidth||1)*s));
21877:       var h=Math.max(1,Math.round((img.naturalHeight||1)*s));
21878:       var c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
21879:       try{c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.72));}
21880:       catch(e){cb('');}
21881:     };
21882:     img.onerror=function(){cb('');};
21883:     img.src=url;
21884:   }

20659:   async function cfFastPrimaryPreview(src,raw){
20660:     if(!src||!src.dataUrl) return null;
20661:     try{
20662:       const img=await Promise.race([
20663:         loadImage(src.dataUrl),
20664:         new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('quick preview decode timeout')),1800))
20665:       ]);
20666:       const iw=img.naturalWidth||img.width,ih=img.naturalHeight||img.height;
20667:       if(!iw||!ih) return src.dataUrl;
20668:       const maxEdge=960,scale=Math.min(1,maxEdge/Math.max(iw,ih));
20669:       const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(iw*scale)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(ih*scale));
20670:       const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
20671:       const x=c.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});x.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;x.imageSmoothingQuality='high';x.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
20672:       // A deliberately conservative, GPU-light optical preview. It never claims structural AI accuracy.
20673:       const facial=((src.category||'').toLowerCase()==='facial')||(!src.intraoral&&src.lips!==false);
20674:       const rx=facial?w*.31:w*.12, ry=facial?h*.50:h*.18, rw=facial?w*.38:w*.76, rh=facial?h*.23:h*.55;
20675:       const tmp=document.createElement('canvas');tmp.width=w;tmp.height=h;
20676:       const tx=tmp.getContext('2d');
20677:       const shade=((raw&&raw.shade)!=null?raw.shade:50); const bright=1+Math.max(0,shade-50)/50*.07;
20678:       tx.filter='brightness('+bright.toFixed(3)+') saturate(.92) contrast(1.025)';tx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);tx.filter='none';
20679:       x.save();x.beginPath();x.ellipse(rx+rw/2,ry+rh/2,rw/2,rh/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);x.clip();x.globalAlpha=.74;x.drawImage(tmp,0,0);x.restore();
20680:       try{drawBadge(x,w,h);}catch(e){}
20681:       const out=c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.82);c.width=c.height=1;tmp.width=tmp.height=1;return out;
20682:     }catch(e){ console.warn('[CaseFlow] quick preview fallback uses source',e); return src.dataUrl; }
20683:   }

20685:   async function produceImage(src){
20686:     const started=performance.now();
20687:     let progressTimer=null, deadlineTimer=null;
20688:     window.__caseflowQuickPreviewUsed=false;
20689:     try{sessionStorage.setItem('cf_primary_generation_guard_v3',JSON.stringify({startedAt:Date.now()}));}catch(e){}
20690:     try{if(window.cfWait)cfWait.show('AIシミュレーション中',0);}catch(e){}

20692:     try{
20693:       await Promise.allSettled([
20694:         Promise.race([ensureIntraoralFlag(src),new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,CF_PRIMARY_PREFLIGHT_MS))]),
20695:         Promise.race([ensureProblemList(src),new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,CF_PRIMARY_PREFLIGHT_MS))])
20696:       ]);
20697:     }catch(e){}
20698:     const preflightMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);
20699:     const aiOn=aiEnabled();
20700:     if(aiOn){
20701:       const msgs=['画像を最適化中…','AIシミュレーション生成中…','臨床デザインを確認中…'];let mi=0;
20702:       const tick=()=>{try{const q=document.querySelector('.cfWaitOverlay .cfWaitSub');if(q)q.textContent=msgs[mi++%msgs.length];}catch(e){}};
20703:       tick();progressTimer=setInterval(tick,2200);
20704:     }
20705:     try{
20706:       if(aiOn){
20707:         const aiTask=generateViaAI(src).then(url=>({kind:'ai',url})).catch(err=>({kind:'error',err}));
20708:         const remaining=Math.max(2500,CF_PRIMARY_RESULT_DEADLINE_MS-(performance.now()-started));
20709:         const deadlineTask=new Promise(resolve=>{deadlineTimer=setTimeout(()=>resolve({kind:'deadline'}),remaining);});
20710:         const result=await Promise.race([aiTask,deadlineTask]);
20711:         if(result&&result.kind==='ai'&&result.url){
20712:           window.__caseflowPrimaryResultMode='ai';return result.url;
20713:         }
20714:         if(result&&result.kind==='error'&&result.err&&result.err.cfNoTokens) throw result.err;
20715:         if(result&&result.kind==='deadline'){try{if(window.__cfGenerationAbort)window.__cfGenerationAbort();}catch(e){}}
20716:         if(result&&result.kind==='error') window.__caseflowLastAIError=String((result.err&&result.err.message)||result.err||'AI error');
20717:       }
20718:       // Absolute contract: always resolve the first result screen without invoking the heavy
20719:       // full-frame local pixel/MediaPipe fallback after an AI stall.
20720:       let quick=null;
20721:       try{quick=await Promise.race([quickTask,new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(()=>resolve(src&&src.dataUrl||null),1200))]);}catch(e){quick=src&&src.dataUrl||null;}
20722:       if(!quick) throw new Error('一次プレビューを作成できませんでした');
20723:       window.__caseflowQuickPreviewUsed=true;window.__caseflowPrimaryResultMode='quick';
20724:       setTimeout(()=>{try{toastFn('通信が時間内に完了しなかったため、軽量プレビューを表示しました。精密生成は結果画面から再実行できます。');}catch(e){}},80);
20725:       return quick;
20726:     } finally {
20727:       clearInterval(progressTimer);clearTimeout(deadlineTimer);
20728:       const totalMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);
20729:       window.__caseflowGenerationTiming={preflight_ms:preflightMs,total_ms:totalMs,mode:window.__caseflowPrimaryResultMode||'unknown',hard_deadline_ms:CF_PRIMARY_RESULT_DEADLINE_MS,completed_at:new Date().toISOString()};
20730:       try{if(typeof window.cfLogEvent==='function')window.cfLogEvent('generation_timing','visual-simulation',window.__caseflowGenerationTiming);}catch(e){}
20731:       try{sessionStorage.removeItem('cf_primary_generation_guard_v3');}catch(e){}
20732:       try{if(window.cfWait)cfWait.hideAll();}catch(e){}
20733:     }

20737:   async function regenerate(){
20738:     if(regenBusy){ regenQueued=true; return; }
20739:     const src=state._simSource||pickSource();
20740:     if(!src) return;
20741:     regenBusy=true; setBusy(true);
20742:     try{
20743:       const url=await produceImage(src);
20744:       // Slider edits UPDATE the currently selected gallery slot in place (other variations
20745:       // stay intact), so re-editing never makes a previously generated image disappear.
20746:       const r=Object.assign({}, state.simResult, {
20747:         dataUrl:url, source:src.dataUrl, srcObj:src, sourceKind:sourceKind(src),
20748:         createdAt:new Date().toISOString(), settings:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.simV96))
20749:       });
20750:       if(Array.isArray(state.simResults) && state.simResults.length){ state.simResults[state.simResultIndex||0]=r; }
20751:       else { state.simResults=[r]; state.simResultIndex=0; }
20752:       state.simResult=r;
20753:       cfAutoSaveTempSim(r);   // ① keep the 48h temp Library copy in sync with slider edits
20754:       renderResultImages();
20755:       // Persist the new result immediately so a reload won't lose it
20756:       try{ if(window.cfPersist) cfPersist.schedule(1000); }catch(e){}
20757:     }catch(e){ console.error(e); toastFn('再生成に失敗しました'); }
20758:     regenBusy=false; setBusy(false);
20759:     if(regenQueued){ regenQueued=false; regenerate(); }
20760:   }

20762:     clearTimeout(regenTimer);
20763:     regenTimer=setTimeout(regenerate, delay==null?60:delay);

20979: <script>
20980: /* ---------- Swipe-from-left = back gesture (smartphone navigation) ---------- */
20981: (function(){
20982:   if(window.__cfSwipeBack) return; window.__cfSwipeBack=true;
20983: 
20984:   // Lightweight navigation history so a back-swipe returns to the previous screen.
20985:   var navHistory=[], navigatingBack=false;
20986:   var prevGo=window.go;
20987:   window.go=function(id){
20988:     var cur=document.querySelector('.screen.active');
20989:     var curId=cur && cur.id;
20990:     var r = prevGo ? prevGo.apply(this,arguments) : undefined;
20991:     if(!navigatingBack && curId && curId!==id){
20992:       if(navHistory[navHistory.length-1]!==curId){
20993:         navHistory.push(curId);
20994:         if(navHistory.length>60) navHistory.shift();
20995:       }
20996:     }
20997:     return r;
20998:   };
20999:   window.cfGoBack=function(){
21000:     if(!navHistory.length) return false;
21001:     var target=navHistory.pop();
21002:     navigatingBack=true;
21003:     try{ window.go(target); } finally { navigatingBack=false; }
21004:     return true;
21005:   };
21006: 
21007:   // If an overlay / modal / sheet is open, let its own close control handle dismissal
21008:   // instead of navigating the screen underneath.
21009:   function overlayOpen(){
21010:     var sel='.cropModal,.photoManagerModal,.sampleVideoOverlay,.sampleVideoSheet,.studioChooserOverlay,.studioChooser,[role="dialog"]';
21011:     var els=document.querySelectorAll(sel);
21012:     for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){
21013:       var el=els[i];
21014:       if(el.offsetParent===null) continue;            // not rendered
21015:       var cs=getComputedStyle(el);
21016:       if(cs.display!=='none' && cs.visibility!=='hidden' && parseFloat(cs.opacity||'1')>0.02 && el.offsetWidth>0 && el.offsetHeight>0){
21017:         return true;
21018:       }
21019:     }
21020:     return false;
21021:   }
21022: 
21023:   // Edge-swipe (start near the left edge, drag right) — mirrors the iOS back gesture and
21024:   // avoids clashing with before/after compare sliders or horizontal content drags.
21025:   var sx=0, sy=0, st=0, tracking=false;
21026:   var EDGE=32, DIST_X=64, MAX_Y=80, MAX_T=800;
21027:   document.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){
21028:     if(e.touches.length!==1){ tracking=false; return; }
21029:     var t=e.touches[0];
21030:     if(t.clientX<=EDGE && !overlayOpen()){ sx=t.clientX; sy=t.clientY; st=Date.now(); tracking=true; }
21031:     else tracking=false;
21032:   },{passive:true});
21033:   document.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){
21034:     if(!tracking) return;
21035:     var t=e.touches[0]; if(!t) return;
21036:     // cancel if the gesture turns mostly vertical (it's a scroll, not a back-swipe)
21037:     if(Math.abs(t.clientY-sy) > Math.abs(t.clientX-sx) && Math.abs(t.clientY-sy)>24) tracking=false;
21038:   },{passive:true});
21039:   document.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){
21040:     if(!tracking) return; tracking=false;
21041:     var t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]; if(!t) return;
21042:     var dx=t.clientX-sx, dy=t.clientY-sy, dt=Date.now()-st;
21043:     if(dx>=DIST_X && Math.abs(dy)<=MAX_Y && dt<=MAX_T && !overlayOpen()){
21044:       window.cfGoBack();
21045:     }
21046:   },{passive:true});
21047: })();

21059:   // --- gray-world white balance (gentle, clamped so shade isn't wildly shifted) ---
21060:   function grayWorld(data){

06416:     return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
06417:       const im=new Image();

06420:       im.src=src;

06424:   function fitContainRect(iw,ih,cw,ch,pad=0){
06425:     const scale=Math.min((cw-pad*2)/iw,(ch-pad*2)/ih);
06426:     const w=iw*scale,h=ih*scale;
06427:     return {x:(cw-w)/2,y:(ch-h)/2,w,h,scale};
06428:   }
06429: 
06430:   function detectContentBox(img, category){
06431:     const w=80,h=80;
06432:     const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=w; c.height=h;
06433:     const ctx=c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
06434:     ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
06435:     const d=ctx.getImageData(0,0,w,h).data;
06436:     let minX=w,minY=h,maxX=0,maxY=0,count=0;
06437:     for(let y=0;y<h;y++){
06438:       for(let x=0;x<w;x++){
06439:         const k=(y*w+x)*4, r=d[k],g=d[k+1],b=d[k+2];
06440:         const bright=(r+g+b)/3;
06441:         const red = r - Math.max(g,b);
06442:         const dark = bright < 170;
06443:         const lip = red > 18 && r > 95;
06444:         const nonWhite = bright < 238 && Math.abs(r-g)+Math.abs(g-b)+Math.abs(r-b) > 18;
06445:         const keep = category==='facial' ? (nonWhite || dark) : (lip || dark || nonWhite);
06446:         if(keep){ minX=Math.min(minX,x); minY=Math.min(minY,y); maxX=Math.max(maxX,x); maxY=Math.max(maxY,y); count++; }
06447:       }
06448:     }
06449:     if(count < 40) return {x:0,y:0,w:img.naturalWidth,h:img.naturalHeight};
06450:     const pad = category==='facial' ? 0.18 : 0.08;
06451:     minX=Math.max(0,minX-(maxX-minX)*pad); maxX=Math.min(w,maxX+(maxX-minX)*pad);
06452:     minY=Math.max(0,minY-(maxY-minY)*pad); maxY=Math.min(h,maxY+(maxY-minY)*pad);
06453:     return {
06454:       x:minX/w*img.naturalWidth,
06455:       y:minY/h*img.naturalHeight,
06456:       w:(maxX-minX)/w*img.naturalWidth,
06457:       h:(maxY-minY)/h*img.naturalHeight
06458:     };
06459:   }
06460: 
06461:   function drawImageFromBox(ctx,img,box,alpha,category,zoom=1,shiftX=0,shiftY=0){
06462:     const cw=ctx.canvas.width,ch=ctx.canvas.height;
06463:     const targetPad = category==='facial' ? Math.round(cw*0.06) : Math.round(cw*0.02);
06464:     const fit=fitContainRect(box.w,box.h,cw,ch,targetPad);
06465:     const w=fit.w*zoom,h=fit.h*zoom;
06466:     const x=(cw-w)/2 + shiftX*cw, y=(ch-h)/2 + shiftY*ch;
06467:     ctx.save();
06468:     ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
06469:     ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
06470:     ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
06471:     ctx.drawImage(img,box.x,box.y,box.w,box.h,x,y,w,h);
06472:     ctx.restore();
06473:   }

06475:   function drawWhiteMatte(ctx,w,h,A,B,e){

06478:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
06479:     [ [A, 0.20*(1-e)], [B, 0.20*e] ].forEach(([im,a])=>{
06480:       if(!im||!im.complete||!im.naturalWidth||a<=0) return;
06481:       const cr = (typeof coverRect === 'function') ? coverRect(im,w,h) : {sx:0,sy:0,sw:im.naturalWidth,sh:im.naturalHeight};
06482:       ctx.globalAlpha=a;
06483:       ctx.filter='blur(40px) saturate(0.96) brightness(1.08)';
06484:       ctx.drawImage(im,cr.sx,cr.sy,cr.sw,cr.sh,0,0,w,h);
06485:     });
06486:     ctx.filter='none';
06487:     ctx.restore();
06488:   }

15975:       const ex = state.projectLibrary.find(r=>r && r.id===autoId);

15982:         return;
15983:       }
15984:     }
15985:     // Fallback: delegate to cfAutoSaveTempSim (compressed storage) if available.
15986:     if(typeof window.cfAutoSaveTempSim==='function'){
15987:       window.cfAutoSaveTempSim(state.simResult);
15988:       toastFn('Simulation image を Library に追加しました');
15989:       return;
15990:     }

15992:     const thumb = (state.simResult.thumb && state.simResult.thumb.length < 400000) ? state.simResult.thumb : '';
15993:     if(!thumb){ toastFn('Simulation image を Library に追加しました'); return; }

15996:     state.projectLibrary.unshift(record);

15998:     if(typeof renderLibrary==='function') renderLibrary();

20887:   window.generateSimulation = async function(){
20888:     const fromSim = !!document.querySelector('#simulator.active');
20889:     const src = pickSource();
20890:     if(!src){ toastFn('Simulation Studio で使用する画像を追加してください'); if(typeof go==='function') go('upload'); return; }
20891: 
20892:     if(fromSim){
20893:       // Preserve v9.5 rule: a chief-complaint card must be chosen on the studio page.
20894:       const t=(state.simV82 && state.simV82.targets) || {};
20895:       if(!Object.keys(t).some(k=>t[k])){
20896:         toastFn('主訴カードを1つ以上選択してください');
20897:         if(typeof window.rebuildSimulationStudioV95==='function') window.rebuildSimulationStudioV95();
20898:         return;
20899:       }
20900:       state.simV96 = Object.assign({}, DEF, deriveFromSelections());
20901:       // Guarantee the FIRST generation shows a visible "after". Shade and Tooth Shape are the
20902:       // only axes the local fallback can render; if both sit at the neutral centre (e.g. an
20903:       // alignment-only complaint, or when the AI backend falls back to local), the output would
20904:       // be identical to the before. Seed a sensible baseline (mild whitening + naturalization).
20905:       const sv=state.simV96;
20906:       if(Math.abs((sv.shade||50)-50)<8 && Math.abs((sv.toothShape||50)-50)<8){
20907:         sv.shade=62; sv.bioBlend=Math.max(sv.bioBlend||50,60);
20908:       }
20909:     }
20910:     state.simV96 = Object.assign({}, DEF, state.simV96||{});
20911:     state._simSource = src;
20912: 
20913:     // ① Any image put through generation/editing is added to the Gallery immediately so it is
20914:     // reusable (e.g. a Sim Studio upload that wasn't in the gallery yet).
20915:     try{
20916:       if(src && src.dataUrl){
20917:         if(!Array.isArray(state.photos)) state.photos=[];
20918:         if(!state.photos.some(p=>p && p.dataUrl===src.dataUrl)){
20919:           state.photos.push(src);
20920:           if(typeof window.renderUpload==='function') window.renderUpload();
20921:           if(typeof window.cfPersist!=='undefined' && window.cfPersist && window.cfPersist.schedule) try{ window.cfPersist.schedule(800); }catch(e){}
20922:         }
20923:       }
20924:     }catch(e){}
20925: 
20926:     const _concept=(state.simV82||{}).concept||'ortho';
20927:     const _ortho=(_concept==='ortho'||_concept==='hybrid');
20928:     // Iterative orthodontic refinement: a REGENERATION (i.e. not the first generation
20929:     // launched from the studio page) builds FURTHER on the after-image already shown in
20930:     // the preview, so each pass keeps improving the alignment instead of restarting from
20931:     // the original. The before image is unaffected — renderResultImages always reads the
20932:     // original from state._simSource.
20933:     let _genSrc = src;
20934:     if(!fromSim && _ortho && state.simResult && state.simResult.dataUrl){
20935:       _genSrc = Object.assign({}, src, {dataUrl: state.simResult.dataUrl});
20936:     }
20937: 
20938:     toastFn(aiEnabled()?'AIで術後イメージを生成中…':'Reference Image を作成中…');
20939:     try{
20940:       const url = await produceImage(_genSrc);
20941:       // Each explicit generation becomes a NEW gallery variation (up to 5) so earlier
20942:       // generations are never lost when you re-edit.
20943:       pushSimResult({
20944:         dataUrl:url, source:src.dataUrl, srcObj:src, sourceKind:sourceKind(src),
20945:         createdAt:new Date().toISOString(), settings:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.simV96))
20946:       });
20947:       if(typeof go==='function') go('result');
20948:       // After an orthodontic generation, recentre the alignment slider so the NEXT
20949:       // regeneration applies a further, incremental correction on top of this result.

20951:       setTimeout(()=>{ renderResultImages(); buildEditGrid(); }, 60);

25134:   // Content descriptor for non-face (e.g. intra-oral) images: brightness-weighted
25135:   // centroid + axis spreads. Used to align by the bright teeth mass when no face exists.
25136:   function contentMoments(img){
25137:     try{
25138:       var W=100, iw=img.naturalWidth||img.width, ih=img.naturalHeight||img.height;
25139:       var H=Math.max(8,Math.round(W*ih/iw));
25140:       var c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=W; c.height=H;
25141:       var x=c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img,0,0,W,H);
25142:       var d; try{ d=x.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data; }catch(e){ return null; }
25143:       var n=W*H, lum=new Float32Array(n), k, mean=0;
25144:       for(k=0;k<n;k++){ var o=k*4; var L=0.299*d[o]+0.587*d[o+1]+0.114*d[o+2]; lum[k]=L; mean+=L; }
25145:       mean/=n; var vr=0; for(k=0;k<n;k++){ var dd=lum[k]-mean; vr+=dd*dd; } var sd=Math.sqrt(vr/n);
25146:       var th=mean+0.30*sd;
25147:       var sum=0,sx=0,sy=0,j,ii;
25148:       for(j=0;j<H;j++)for(ii=0;ii<W;ii++){ var w=lum[j*W+ii]-th; if(w>0){ sum+=w; sx+=w*ii; sy+=w*j; } }
25149:       if(sum<1e-3) return null;
25150:       var cx=sx/sum, cy=sy/sum, cxx=0,cyy=0;
25151:       for(j=0;j<H;j++)for(ii=0;ii<W;ii++){ var w2=lum[j*W+ii]-th; if(w2>0){ var ax=ii-cx, ay=j-cy; cxx+=w2*ax*ax; cyy+=w2*ay*ay; } }
25152:       cxx/=sum; cyy/=sum;
25153:       return {cx:cx/W, cy:cy/H, sx:Math.sqrt(cxx)/W, sy:Math.sqrt(cyy)/H};
25154:     }catch(e){ return null; }
25155:   }

25157:   // 2D similarity least-squares: maps src points → dst points → {scale,rot,tx,ty}
25158:   function solveSimilarity(src,dst){
25159:     var n=Math.min(src.length,dst.length);
25160:     if(n<2) return {scale:1,rot:0,tx:0,ty:0};
25161:     var ma={x:0,y:0}, mb={x:0,y:0}, i;
25162:     for(i=0;i<n;i++){ ma.x+=src[i].x; ma.y+=src[i].y; mb.x+=dst[i].x; mb.y+=dst[i].y; }
25163:     ma.x/=n; ma.y/=n; mb.x/=n; mb.y/=n;
25164:     var c=0,d=0,Saa=0;
25165:     for(i=0;i<n;i++){
25166:       var ax=src[i].x-ma.x, ay=src[i].y-ma.y;
25167:       var bx=dst[i].x-mb.x, by=dst[i].y-mb.y;
25168:       c+=ax*bx+ay*by;   // dot
25169:       d+=ax*by-ay*bx;   // cross
25170:       Saa+=ax*ax+ay*ay;
25171:     }
25172:     var rot=Math.atan2(d,c);
25173:     var scale=Saa>1e-6?Math.sqrt(c*c+d*d)/Saa:1;
25174:     scale=clamp(scale,0.3,3.0);
25175:     var cos=Math.cos(rot), sin=Math.sin(rot);
25176:     var tx=mb.x-scale*(cos*ma.x-sin*ma.y);
25177:     var ty=mb.y-scale*(sin*ma.x+cos*ma.y);
25178:     return {scale:scale,rot:rot,tx:tx,ty:ty};
25179:   }

20630:   async function ensureIntraoralFlag(src){
20631:     if(!src || !src.dataUrl) return false;
20632:     const resolveLips=()=>{
20633:       if(typeof src.lips!=='boolean') src.lips=(((src.category||'').toLowerCase()==='facial') && !src.intraoral);
20634:     };
20635:     if(typeof src.intraoral==='boolean' && typeof src.intraoralDark==='boolean'){ resolveLips(); return src.intraoral; }
20636:     try{
20637:       if(window.caseflowLocalAnalyze){
20638:         const timeoutToken={cfTimeout:true};
20639:         const a=await Promise.race([
20640:           window.caseflowLocalAnalyze(src.dataUrl,src.category||null),
20641:           new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(()=>resolve(timeoutToken),650))
20642:         ]);
20643:         if(a!==timeoutToken){
20644:           src.intraoral=!!(a&&a.intraoral); src.intraoralDark=!!(a&&a.intraoralDark);
20645:           resolveLips(); return src.intraoral;
20646:         }
20647:       }
20648:     }catch(e){}
20649:     // Generation may never wait for analysis. Category and upload controls are the safe default.
20650:     if(typeof src.intraoral!=='boolean') src.intraoral=((src.category||'').toLowerCase()==='intraoral');
20651:     if(typeof src.intraoralDark!=='boolean') src.intraoralDark=false;
20652:     resolveLips(); return src.intraoral;
20653:   }

20659:   async function cfFastPrimaryPreview(src,raw){
20660:     if(!src||!src.dataUrl) return null;
20661:     try{
20662:       const img=await Promise.race([
20663:         loadImage(src.dataUrl),
20664:         new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('quick preview decode timeout')),1800))
20665:       ]);
20666:       const iw=img.naturalWidth||img.width,ih=img.naturalHeight||img.height;
20667:       if(!iw||!ih) return src.dataUrl;
20668:       const maxEdge=960,scale=Math.min(1,maxEdge/Math.max(iw,ih));
20669:       const w=Math.max(1,Math.round(iw*scale)),h=Math.max(1,Math.round(ih*scale));
20670:       const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=w;c.height=h;
20671:       const x=c.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});x.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;x.imageSmoothingQuality='high';x.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
20672:       // A deliberately conservative, GPU-light optical preview. It never claims structural AI accuracy.
20673:       const facial=((src.category||'').toLowerCase()==='facial')||(!src.intraoral&&src.lips!==false);
20674:       const rx=facial?w*.31:w*.12, ry=facial?h*.50:h*.18, rw=facial?w*.38:w*.76, rh=facial?h*.23:h*.55;
20675:       const tmp=document.createElement('canvas');tmp.width=w;tmp.height=h;
20676:       const tx=tmp.getContext('2d');
20677:       const shade=((raw&&raw.shade)!=null?raw.shade:50); const bright=1+Math.max(0,shade-50)/50*.07;
20678:       tx.filter='brightness('+bright.toFixed(3)+') saturate(.92) contrast(1.025)';tx.drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);tx.filter='none';
20679:       x.save();x.beginPath();x.ellipse(rx+rw/2,ry+rh/2,rw/2,rh/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);x.clip();x.globalAlpha=.74;x.drawImage(tmp,0,0);x.restore();
20680:       try{drawBadge(x,w,h);}catch(e){}
20681:       const out=c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.82);c.width=c.height=1;tmp.width=tmp.height=1;return out;
20682:     }catch(e){ console.warn('[CaseFlow] quick preview fallback uses source',e); return src.dataUrl; }
20683:   }

20887:   window.generateSimulation = async function(){
20888:     const fromSim = !!document.querySelector('#simulator.active');
20889:     const src = pickSource();
20890:     if(!src){ toastFn('Simulation Studio で使用する画像を追加してください'); if(typeof go==='function') go('upload'); return; }
20891: 
20892:     if(fromSim){
20893:       // Preserve v9.5 rule: a chief-complaint card must be chosen on the studio page.
20894:       const t=(state.simV82 && state.simV82.targets) || {};
20895:       if(!Object.keys(t).some(k=>t[k])){
20896:         toastFn('主訴カードを1つ以上選択してください');
20897:         if(typeof window.rebuildSimulationStudioV95==='function') window.rebuildSimulationStudioV95();
20898:         return;
20899:       }
20900:       state.simV96 = Object.assign({}, DEF, deriveFromSelections());
20901:       // Guarantee the FIRST generation shows a visible "after". Shade and Tooth Shape are the
20902:       // only axes the local fallback can render; if both sit at the neutral centre (e.g. an
20903:       // alignment-only complaint, or when the AI backend falls back to local), the output would
20904:       // be identical to the before. Seed a sensible baseline (mild whitening + naturalization).
20905:       const sv=state.simV96;
20906:       if(Math.abs((sv.shade||50)-50)<8 && Math.abs((sv.toothShape||50)-50)<8){
20907:         sv.shade=62; sv.bioBlend=Math.max(sv.bioBlend||50,60);
20908:       }
20909:     }
20910:     state.simV96 = Object.assign({}, DEF, state.simV96||{});
20911:     state._simSource = src;
20912: 
20913:     // ① Any image put through generation/editing is added to the Gallery immediately so it is
20914:     // reusable (e.g. a Sim Studio upload that wasn't in the gallery yet).
20915:     try{
20916:       if(src && src.dataUrl){
20917:         if(!Array.isArray(state.photos)) state.photos=[];
20918:         if(!state.photos.some(p=>p && p.dataUrl===src.dataUrl)){
20919:           state.photos.push(src);
20920:           if(typeof window.renderUpload==='function') window.renderUpload();
20921:           if(typeof window.cfPersist!=='undefined' && window.cfPersist && window.cfPersist.schedule) try{ window.cfPersist.schedule(800); }catch(e){}
20922:         }
20923:       }
20924:     }catch(e){}
20925: 
20926:     const _concept=(state.simV82||{}).concept||'ortho';
20927:     const _ortho=(_concept==='ortho'||_concept==='hybrid');

20984:   // Lightweight navigation history so a back-swipe returns to the previous screen.
20985:   var navHistory=[], navigatingBack=false;
20986:   var prevGo=window.go;
20987:   window.go=function(id){
20988:     var cur=document.querySelector('.screen.active');
20989:     var curId=cur && cur.id;
20990:     var r = prevGo ? prevGo.apply(this,arguments) : undefined;
20991:     if(!navigatingBack && curId && curId!==id){
20992:       if(navHistory[navHistory.length-1]!==curId){
20993:         navHistory.push(curId);
20994:         if(navHistory.length>60) navHistory.shift();
20995:       }

20997:     return r;
20998:   };
20999:   window.cfGoBack=function(){
21000:     if(!navHistory.length) return false;
21001:     var target=navHistory.pop();
21002:     navigatingBack=true;
21003:     try{ window.go(target); } finally { navigatingBack=false; }
21004:     return true;
21005:   };

21007:   // If an overlay / modal / sheet is open, let its own close control handle dismissal
21008:   // instead of navigating the screen underneath.
21009:   function overlayOpen(){
21010:     var sel='.cropModal,.photoManagerModal,.sampleVideoOverlay,.sampleVideoSheet,.studioChooserOverlay,.studioChooser,[role="dialog"]';
21011:     var els=document.querySelectorAll(sel);
21012:     for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){
21013:       var el=els[i];
21014:       if(el.offsetParent===null) continue;            // not rendered
21015:       var cs=getComputedStyle(el);
21016:       if(cs.display!=='none' && cs.visibility!=='hidden' && parseFloat(cs.opacity||'1')>0.02 && el.offsetWidth>0 && el.offsetHeight>0){
21017:         return true;
21018:       }
21019:     }
21020:     return false;
21021:   }
21022: 
21023:   // Edge-swipe (start near the left edge, drag right) — mirrors the iOS back gesture and
21024:   // avoids clashing with before/after compare sliders or horizontal content drags.
21025:   var sx=0, sy=0, st=0, tracking=false;
21026:   var EDGE=32, DIST_X=64, MAX_Y=80, MAX_T=800;
21027:   document.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){
21028:     if(e.touches.length!==1){ tracking=false; return; }
21029:     var t=e.touches[0];
21030:     if(t.clientX<=EDGE && !overlayOpen()){ sx=t.clientX; sy=t.clientY; st=Date.now(); tracking=true; }
21031:     else tracking=false;
21032:   },{passive:true});
21033:   document.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){
21034:     if(!tracking) return;
21035:     var t=e.touches[0]; if(!t) return;
21036:     // cancel if the gesture turns mostly vertical (it's a scroll, not a back-swipe)
21037:     if(Math.abs(t.clientY-sy) > Math.abs(t.clientX-sx) && Math.abs(t.clientY-sy)>24) tracking=false;
21038:   },{passive:true});
21039:   document.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){
21040:     if(!tracking) return; tracking=false;
21041:     var t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]; if(!t) return;
21042:     var dx=t.clientX-sx, dy=t.clientY-sy, dt=Date.now()-st;
21043:     if(dx>=DIST_X && Math.abs(dy)<=MAX_Y && dt<=MAX_T && !overlayOpen()){
21044:       window.cfGoBack();
21045:     }
21046:   },{passive:true});
21047: })();

21059:   // --- gray-world white balance (gentle, clamped so shade isn't wildly shifted) ---
21060:   function grayWorld(data){
21061:     var r=0,g=0,b=0,n=data.length/4,i;
21062:     for(i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){ r+=data[i]; g+=data[i+1]; b+=data[i+2]; }
21063:     r/=n; g/=n; b/=n; var gray=(r+g+b)/3;
21064:     var kr=gray/(r||1), kg=gray/(g||1), kb=gray/(b||1);
21065:     var cl=function(k){ return Math.min(1.5,Math.max(0.7,k)); };
21066:     kr=cl(kr); kg=cl(kg); kb=cl(kb);
21067:     for(i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){
21068:       data[i]=Math.min(255,data[i]*kr); data[i+1]=Math.min(255,data[i+1]*kg); data[i+2]=Math.min(255,data[i+2]*kb);
21069:     }
21070:   }

20981: (function(){

20984:   // Lightweight navigation history so a back-swipe returns to the previous screen.
20985:   var navHistory=[], navigatingBack=false;
20986:   var prevGo=window.go;
20987:   window.go=function(id){
20988:     var cur=document.querySelector('.screen.active');
20989:     var curId=cur && cur.id;
20990:     var r = prevGo ? prevGo.apply(this,arguments) : undefined;
20991:     if(!navigatingBack && curId && curId!==id){
20992:       if(navHistory[navHistory.length-1]!==curId){
20993:         navHistory.push(curId);
20994:         if(navHistory.length>60) navHistory.shift();
20995:       }
20996:     }
20997:     return r;
20998:   };
20999:   window.cfGoBack=function(){
21000:     if(!navHistory.length) return false;
21001:     var target=navHistory.pop();
21002:     navigatingBack=true;
21003:     try{ window.go(target); } finally { navigatingBack=false; }
21004:     return true;
21005:   };

21007:   // If an overlay / modal / sheet is open, let its own close control handle dismissal
21008:   // instead of navigating the screen underneath.
21009:   function overlayOpen(){
21010:     var sel='.cropModal,.photoManagerModal,.sampleVideoOverlay,.sampleVideoSheet,.studioChooserOverlay,.studioChooser,[role="dialog"]';
21011:     var els=document.querySelectorAll(sel);
21012:     for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++){
21013:       var el=els[i];
21014:       if(el.offsetParent===null) continue;            // not rendered
21015:       var cs=getComputedStyle(el);
21016:       if(cs.display!=='none' && cs.visibility!=='hidden' && parseFloat(cs.opacity||'1')>0.02 && el.offsetWidth>0 && el.offsetHeight>0){
21017:         return true;
21018:       }
21019:     }
21020:     return false;
21021:   }

21023:   // Edge-swipe (start near the left edge, drag right) — mirrors the iOS back gesture and
21024:   // avoids clashing with before/after compare sliders or horizontal content drags.
21025:   var sx=0, sy=0, st=0, tracking=false;
21026:   var EDGE=32, DIST_X=64, MAX_Y=80, MAX_T=800;
21027:   document.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){
21028:     if(e.touches.length!==1){ tracking=false; return; }
21029:     var t=e.touches[0];
21030:     if(t.clientX<=EDGE && !overlayOpen()){ sx=t.clientX; sy=t.clientY; st=Date.now(); tracking=true; }
21031:     else tracking=false;
21032:   },{passive:true});
21033:   document.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){
21034:     if(!tracking) return;
21035:     var t=e.touches[0]; if(!t) return;
21036:     // cancel if the gesture turns mostly vertical (it's a scroll, not a back-swipe)
21037:     if(Math.abs(t.clientY-sy) > Math.abs(t.clientX-sx) && Math.abs(t.clientY-sy)>24) tracking=false;
21038:   },{passive:true});
21039:   document.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){
21040:     if(!tracking) return; tracking=false;
21041:     var t=e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]; if(!t) return;
21042:     var dx=t.clientX-sx, dy=t.clientY-sy, dt=Date.now()-st;
21043:     if(dx>=DIST_X && Math.abs(dy)<=MAX_Y && dt<=MAX_T && !overlayOpen()){
21044:       window.cfGoBack();
21045:     }
21046:   },{passive:true});
21047: })();

21059:   // --- gray-world white balance (gentle, clamped so shade isn't wildly shifted) ---
21060:   function grayWorld(data){
21061:     var r=0,g=0,b=0,n=data.length/4,i;
21062:     for(i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){ r+=data[i]; g+=data[i+1]; b+=data[i+2]; }
21063:     r/=n; g/=n; b/=n; var gray=(r+g+b)/3;
21064:     var kr=gray/(r||1), kg=gray/(g||1), kb=gray/(b||1);
21065:     var cl=function(k){ return Math.min(1.5,Math.max(0.7,k)); };
21066:     kr=cl(kr); kg=cl(kg); kb=cl(kb);
21067:     for(i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){
21068:       data[i]=Math.min(255,data[i]*kr); data[i+1]=Math.min(255,data[i+1]*kg); data[i+2]=Math.min(255,data[i+2]*kb);
21069:     }
21070:   }

12874:       if((_vdef.oralSoftDiss||0)>0 && oralROI && oralROI.detected){
12875:         cfApplyOralSoftDissolve(ctx,baseB,oralROI,eW,_vdef.oralSoftDiss,w,h);
12876:       }
12877:     }
12878:     if(state.meshOverlayEnabled){
12879:       ctx.save();
12880:       ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(32,27,53,.28)';
12881:       ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(0.75,w/1400);
12882:       tris.forEach(([i,j,k])=>{
12883:         ctx.beginPath();
12884:         ctx.moveTo(mid[i].x,mid[i].y);
12885:         ctx.lineTo(mid[j].x,mid[j].y);
12886:         ctx.lineTo(mid[k].x,mid[k].y);
12887:         ctx.closePath();
12888:         ctx.stroke();
12889:       });
12890:       // show user landmarks as bright anchors
12891:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.92)';
12892:       pairs.forEach((p,idx)=>{

12896:       });

12898:     }

12904:   // ── Dental ROI Protection helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────
12905:   // cfComputeDentalROI — detect the oral/dental region in both source images.
12906:   // Returns {cxA,cyA,rxA,ryA,cxB,cyB,rxB,ryB,detected}. Prefers face-mesh;
12907:   // falls back to a facial-proportion heuristic.
12908:   const _dentalDiffCache=new Map();
12909:   function cfComputeDentalROI(photoA,photoB,rectA,rectB,w,h){
12910:     function mouthFrom(mesh,rect){
12911:       // MediaPipe face: mouth zone ≈ y∈[0.57,0.84], x∈[0.24,0.76]
12912:       const pts=mesh.filter(function(p){return p.y>0.57&&p.y<0.84&&p.x>0.24&&p.x<0.76;});
12913:       if(pts.length<3) return null;
12914:       const px=pts.map(function(p){return rect.x+p.x*rect.w;});
12915:       const py=pts.map(function(p){return rect.y+p.y*rect.h;});
12916:       const minX=Math.min.apply(null,px),maxX=Math.max.apply(null,px);
12917:       const minY=Math.min.apply(null,py),maxY=Math.max.apply(null,py);
12918:       return{
12919:         cx:(minX+maxX)*0.5,
12920:         cy:(minY+maxY)*0.5+(maxY-minY)*0.09, // nudge center toward teeth
12921:         rx:(maxX-minX)*0.48,
12922:         ry:(maxY-minY)*0.38
12923:       };
12924:     }
12925:     let cxA,cyA,rxA,ryA,cxB,cyB,rxB,ryB,detected=false;
12926:     const ma=photoA&&photoA._faceMesh,mb=photoB&&photoB._faceMesh;
12927:     if(ma&&mb){
12928:       const mA=mouthFrom(ma,rectA),mB=mouthFrom(mb,rectB);
12929:       if(mA&&mB){
12930:         cxA=mA.cx;cyA=mA.cy;rxA=mA.rx;ryA=mA.ry;
12931:         cxB=mB.cx;cyB=mB.cy;rxB=mB.rx;ryB=mB.ry;
12932:         detected=true;
12933:       }
12934:     }
12935:     if(!detected){
12936:       // Heuristic: teeth sit at ~65% face height, centred, ~22% half-width
12937:       cxA=rectA.x+rectA.w*0.5; cyA=rectA.y+rectA.h*0.665;
12938:       cxB=rectB.x+rectB.w*0.5; cyB=rectB.y+rectB.h*0.665;
12939:       rxA=rxB=Math.min(rectA.w,rectB.w)*0.22;
12940:       ryA=ryB=Math.min(rectA.h,rectB.h)*0.065;
12941:     }
12942:     return{cxA,cyA,rxA,ryA,cxB,cyB,rxB,ryB,detected};
12943:   }
12944: 
12945:   // cfComputeDentalDiff — mean absolute brightness difference in dental ROI,
12946:   // cached per photo pair so getImageData is only called once per pair.
12947:   function cfComputeDentalDiff(baseA,baseB,roi,photoA,photoB){
12948:     const ka=(photoA.dataUrl||'').slice(-28);
12949:     const kb=(photoB.dataUrl||'').slice(-28);
12950:     const ck=ka+'|'+kb;
12951:     if(_dentalDiffCache.has(ck)) return _dentalDiffCache.get(ck);
12952:     try{
12953:       const rx=Math.max(24,Math.ceil(roi.rxA)),ry=Math.max(14,Math.ceil(roi.ryA));
12954:       const sx=Math.max(0,Math.round(roi.cxA-rx)),sy=Math.max(0,Math.round(roi.cyA-ry));
12955:       const sw=Math.min(baseA.width-sx,rx*2),sh=Math.min(baseA.height-sy,ry*2);
12956:       if(sw<2||sh<2){_dentalDiffCache.set(ck,0);return 0;}
12957:       const pdA=baseA.getContext('2d').getImageData(sx,sy,sw,sh).data;
12958:       const sxB=Math.max(0,Math.round(roi.cxB-rx)),syB=Math.max(0,Math.round(roi.cyB-ry));
12959:       const swB=Math.min(baseB.width-sxB,rx*2),shB=Math.min(baseB.height-syB,ry*2);
12960:       const pdB=(swB>=2&&shB>=2)
12961:         ?baseB.getContext('2d').getImageData(sxB,syB,swB,shB).data
12962:         :baseB.getContext('2d').getImageData(sx,sy,sw,sh).data;
12963:       let tot=0,cnt=0;
12964:       const step=4*5; // sample every 5th pixel
12965:       for(let i=0;i<pdA.length&&i<pdB.length;i+=step){
12966:         const bA=(pdA[i]*0.299+pdA[i+1]*0.587+pdA[i+2]*0.114)/255;
12967:         const bB=(pdB[i]*0.299+pdB[i+1]*0.587+pdB[i+2]*0.114)/255;
12968:         tot+=Math.abs(bA-bB);cnt++;
12969:       }
14277:     if(!old || old.dataset.v75Cleaned==='1') return old;
14278:     const fresh=old.cloneNode(false);
14279:     fresh.id='landmarkSvg';
14280:     fresh.className.baseVal = old.className.baseVal || 'landmarkSvg';
14281:     fresh.dataset.v75Cleaned='1';
14282:     old.replaceWith(fresh);
14283:     return fresh;
14284:   }

28718: <!-- ============ Dental Event Plan: AI-assisted case analysis + event-aware morph phases ============ -->
28719: <script>
28720: /* Morphing Video Studio — event-aware morphing (Phase 3/4).
28721:    方針: AI(Gemini)は「構造理解」(症例分類/イベント検出/マスク提案)のみに使用し、
28722:    最終フレームは従来どおりローカルの mesh warp が描く。全体フェードを主処理にせず、
28723:    ブラケット除去・補綴出現・抜歯矯正はフェーズ分解＋局所マスク処理で扱う。
28724:    AI提案は必ずユーザー確認（適用/破棄）を経てから使われる。 */
28725: (function(){
28726:   var CASE_TYPES=[
28727:     ['standard_dental_morph','標準モーフ','通常の歯列移動・スマイル改善'],
28728:     ['appliance_cleanup','装置除去','ブラケット・ワイヤー・アタッチメント除去'],
28729:     ['space_closure','空隙閉鎖','正中離開・空隙歯列・スペース閉鎖'],
28730:     ['prosthetic_emergence','補綴出現','欠損補綴・インプラント・ブリッジ・ベニア'],
28731:     ['extraction_ortho','抜歯矯正','抜歯・スペース閉鎖・前歯部後退の複合'],
28732:     ['mixed_event','複合イベント','複数イベントの同時進行'],
28733:     ['unknown','不明','自動分類に自信なし']
28734:   ];

28738:   function ss(x){ x=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x)); return x*x*(3-2*x); }
28739:   function toastFn(m){ if(typeof toast==='function') toast(m); else console.log(m); }

28741:   /* ---- phase remap: case type → warp progress + local mask ops ---- */
28742:   function planPhases(t, plan){
28743:     var ops=[]; var warpT=t;
28744:     var mk=plan.masks||{};
28745:     var appl=[].concat(mk.brackets||[], mk.wires||[], mk.attachments||[]);
28746:     var emrg=[].concat(mk.missing_spaces||[], mk.prosthetic_emergence_regions||[]);
28747:     var extr=[].concat(mk.extraction_spaces||[]);
28748:     switch(plan.case_type){
28749:       case 'appliance_cleanup':
28750:         warpT=ss((t-0.20)/0.80);
28751:         if(appl.length && t<0.55) ops.push({rects:appl, mode:'soften', alpha:ss(t/0.20)*(1-ss((t-0.38)/0.17))});
28752:         break;
28753:       case 'prosthetic_emergence':
28754:         warpT=ss(t);
28755:         if(emrg.length && t<0.88) ops.push({rects:emrg, mode:'holdBefore', alpha:1-ss((t-0.55)/0.30)});
28756:         break;
28757:       case 'extraction_ortho':
28758:         if(t<0.18){ warpT=0; if(extr.length) ops.push({rects:extr, mode:'soften', alpha:ss(t/0.18)}); }
28759:         else { warpT=ss((t-0.18)/0.82); if(extr.length && t<0.40) ops.push({rects:extr, mode:'soften', alpha:1-ss((t-0.18)/0.22)}); }
28760:         break;
28761:       case 'mixed_event':
28762:         warpT=ss((t-0.15)/0.70);
28763:         if(appl.length && t<0.40) ops.push({rects:appl, mode:'soften', alpha:ss(t/0.15)*(1-ss((t-0.28)/0.12))});
28764:         if(emrg.length && t<0.90) ops.push({rects:emrg, mode:'holdBefore', alpha:1-ss((t-0.60)/0.28)});
28765:         break;
28766:       default: /* standard_dental_morph / space_closure / unknown → mesh warp as-is */
28767:         warpT=t;
28768:     }
28769:     return { warpT:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,warpT)), ops:ops };
28770:   }

28772:   /* ---- local mask pass: draw a feathered patch of the BEFORE image over the composite.
28773:      'soften' blurs the patch (装置・抜歯部位の局所軟化), 'holdBefore' keeps the region
28774:      showing Before longer so 補綴は局所的に遅れて出現する。 ---- */
28775:   var _imgCache=new Map();
28776:   function imgFor(dataUrl){
28777:     var im=_imgCache.get(dataUrl);
28778:     if(!im){ im=new Image(); im.src=dataUrl; _imgCache.set(dataUrl, im); }
28779:     return im;
28780:   }
28781:   function containFit(iw, ih, w, h){
28782:     var s=Math.min(w/iw, h/ih), fw=iw*s, fh=ih*s;
28783:     return { x:(w-fw)/2, y:(h-fh)/2, w:fw, h:fh };
28784:   }
28785:   function applyMaskOps(canvas, beforePhoto, ops){
28786:     if(!ops.length || !beforePhoto || !beforePhoto.dataUrl) return;
28787:     var img=imgFor(beforePhoto.dataUrl);
28788:     if(!img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return;
28789:     var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'), w=canvas.width, h=canvas.height;
28790:     var fit=containFit(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight, w, h);
28791:     ops.forEach(function(op){
28792:       var a=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,op.alpha)); if(a<=0.01) return;
28793:       op.rects.forEach(function(r){
28794:         var px=fit.x+r.x*fit.w, py=fit.y+r.y*fit.h, pw=r.w*fit.w, ph=r.h*fit.h;
28795:         if(pw<3||ph<3) return;
28796:         var rad=Math.min(pw,ph)*0.35;
28797:         ctx.save();
28798:         ctx.beginPath();
28799:         if(ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(px,py,pw,ph,rad); else ctx.rect(px,py,pw,ph);
28800:         ctx.clip();
28801:         ctx.globalAlpha=a;
28802:         if(op.mode==='soften') ctx.filter='blur('+Math.max(4,Math.round(Math.min(pw,ph)*0.18))+'px) brightness(1.06) saturate(1.02)';
28803:         ctx.drawImage(img, fit.x, fit.y, fit.w, fit.h);
28804:         ctx.restore();
28805:       });
28806:     });
28807:   }

28809:   /* ---- wrap the shared production renderer (preview AND export resolve
28810:      window.cfDrawMorphFrame at call time, so both get the same event plan) ---- */
28811:   function installWrap(){
28812:     if(window.__cfEventWrapInstalled || typeof window.cfDrawMorphFrame!=='function') return;
28813:     window.__cfEventWrapInstalled=true;
28814:     var core=window.cfDrawMorphFrame;
28815:     window.cfDrawMorphFrame=async function(canvas, t, options){
28816:       var plan=state.morphEventPlan;
28817:       /* Rollback switch (§legacy fallback): window.CF_DISABLE_EVENT_MORPH=true
28818:          restores the previous stable renderer without removing the feature.
28819:          t always comes from the caller — the phase remap derives from it and
28820:          still progresses 0→1; it is never frozen to a constant. */
28821:       if(window.CF_DISABLE_EVENT_MORPH || !plan || !plan.confirmed) return core(canvas, t, options);
28822:       var ph=planPhases(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)), plan);
28823:       var out=await core(canvas, ph.warpT, options);
28824:       try{

28826:         var aIdx=(options&&options.aIndex)||0;
28827:         applyMaskOps(canvas, photos[aIdx], ph.ops);
28828:       }catch(e){ /* mask pass must never break the frame */ }
28829:       return out;
28830:     };
28831:   }
28832:   installWrap();

28834:   setTimeout(installWrap, 1500);

28836:   window.cfEventPlanPhases=planPhases;

28725: (function(){

28741:   /* ---- phase remap: case type → warp progress + local mask ops ---- */
28742:   function planPhases(t, plan){
28743:     var ops=[]; var warpT=t;
28744:     var mk=plan.masks||{};
28745:     var appl=[].concat(mk.brackets||[], mk.wires||[], mk.attachments||[]);
28746:     var emrg=[].concat(mk.missing_spaces||[], mk.prosthetic_emergence_regions||[]);
28747:     var extr=[].concat(mk.extraction_spaces||[]);
28748:     switch(plan.case_type){
28749:       case 'appliance_cleanup':
28750:         warpT=ss((t-0.20)/0.80);
28751:         if(appl.length && t<0.55) ops.push({rects:appl, mode:'soften', alpha:ss(t/0.20)*(1-ss((t-0.38)/0.17))});
28752:         break;
28753:       case 'prosthetic_emergence':
28754:         warpT=ss(t);
28755:         if(emrg.length && t<0.88) ops.push({rects:emrg, mode:'holdBefore', alpha:1-ss((t-0.55)/0.30)});
28756:         break;
28757:       case 'extraction_ortho':
28758:         if(t<0.18){ warpT=0; if(extr.length) ops.push({rects:extr, mode:'soften', alpha:ss(t/0.18)}); }
28759:         else { warpT=ss((t-0.18)/0.82); if(extr.length && t<0.40) ops.push({rects:extr, mode:'soften', alpha:1-ss((t-0.18)/0.22)}); }
28760:         break;
28761:       case 'mixed_event':
28762:         warpT=ss((t-0.15)/0.70);
28763:         if(appl.length && t<0.40) ops.push({rects:appl, mode:'soften', alpha:ss(t/0.15)*(1-ss((t-0.28)/0.12))});
28764:         if(emrg.length && t<0.90) ops.push({rects:emrg, mode:'holdBefore', alpha:1-ss((t-0.60)/0.28)});
28765:         break;
28766:       default: /* standard_dental_morph / space_closure / unknown → mesh warp as-is */
28767:         warpT=t;
28768:     }
28769:     return { warpT:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,warpT)), ops:ops };
28770:   }

28775:   var _imgCache=new Map();
28776:   function imgFor(dataUrl){

28781:   function containFit(iw, ih, w, h){
28782:     var s=Math.min(w/iw, h/ih), fw=iw*s, fh=ih*s;
28783:     return { x:(w-fw)/2, y:(h-fh)/2, w:fw, h:fh };
28784:   }
28785:   function applyMaskOps(canvas, beforePhoto, ops){
28786:     if(!ops.length || !beforePhoto || !beforePhoto.dataUrl) return;
28787:     var img=imgFor(beforePhoto.dataUrl);
28788:     if(!img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return;
28789:     var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'), w=canvas.width, h=canvas.height;
28790:     var fit=containFit(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight, w, h);
28791:     ops.forEach(function(op){
28792:       var a=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,op.alpha)); if(a<=0.01) return;
28793:       op.rects.forEach(function(r){
28794:         var px=fit.x+r.x*fit.w, py=fit.y+r.y*fit.h, pw=r.w*fit.w, ph=r.h*fit.h;
28795:         if(pw<3||ph<3) return;
28796:         var rad=Math.min(pw,ph)*0.35;
28797:         ctx.save();
28798:         ctx.beginPath();
28799:         if(ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(px,py,pw,ph,rad); else ctx.rect(px,py,pw,ph);
28800:         ctx.clip();
28801:         ctx.globalAlpha=a;
28802:         if(op.mode==='soften') ctx.filter='blur('+Math.max(4,Math.round(Math.min(pw,ph)*0.18))+'px) brightness(1.06) saturate(1.02)';
28803:         ctx.drawImage(img, fit.x, fit.y, fit.w, fit.h);
28804:         ctx.restore();
28805:       });
28806:     });

28783:     return { x:(w-fw)/2, y:(h-fh)/2, w:fw, h:fh };

28785:   function applyMaskOps(canvas, beforePhoto, ops){
28786:     if(!ops.length || !beforePhoto || !beforePhoto.dataUrl) return;
28787:     var img=imgFor(beforePhoto.dataUrl);
28788:     if(!img.complete || !img.naturalWidth) return;
28789:     var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'), w=canvas.width, h=canvas.height;
28790:     var fit=containFit(img.naturalWidth, img.naturalHeight, w, h);
28791:     ops.forEach(function(op){
28792:       var a=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,op.alpha)); if(a<=0.01) return;
28793:       op.rects.forEach(function(r){
28794:         var px=fit.x+r.x*fit.w, py=fit.y+r.y*fit.h, pw=r.w*fit.w, ph=r.h*fit.h;
28795:         if(pw<3||ph<3) return;
28796:         var rad=Math.min(pw,ph)*0.35;
28797:         ctx.save();
28798:         ctx.beginPath();
28799:         if(ctx.roundRect) ctx.roundRect(px,py,pw,ph,rad); else ctx.rect(px,py,pw,ph);
28800:         ctx.clip();
28801:         ctx.globalAlpha=a;
28802:         if(op.mode==='soften') ctx.filter='blur('+Math.max(4,Math.round(Math.min(pw,ph)*0.18))+'px) brightness(1.06) saturate(1.02)';
28803:         ctx.drawImage(img, fit.x, fit.y, fit.w, fit.h);
28804:         ctx.restore();
28805:       });
28806:     });
28807:   }

28809:   /* ---- wrap the shared production renderer (preview AND export resolve
28810:      window.cfDrawMorphFrame at call time, so both get the same event plan) ---- */
28811:   function installWrap(){
28812:     if(window.__cfEventWrapInstalled || typeof window.cfDrawMorphFrame!=='function') return;
28813:     window.__cfEventWrapInstalled=true;
28814:     var core=window.cfDrawMorphFrame;
28815:     window.cfDrawMorphFrame=async function(canvas, t, options){
28816:       var plan=state.morphEventPlan;
28817:       /* Rollback switch (§legacy fallback): window.CF_DISABLE_EVENT_MORPH=true
28818:          restores the previous stable renderer without removing the feature.
28819:          t always comes from the caller — the phase remap derives from it and
28820:          still progresses 0→1; it is never frozen to a constant. */
28821:       if(window.CF_DISABLE_EVENT_MORPH || !plan || !plan.confirmed) return core(canvas, t, options);
28822:       var ph=planPhases(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)), plan);
28823:       var out=await core(canvas, ph.warpT, options);
28824:       try{
28825:         var photos=(typeof window.cfGetMorphSource==='function')?window.cfGetMorphSource():((state&&state.photos)||[]);
28826:         var aIdx=(options&&options.aIndex)||0;
28827:         applyMaskOps(canvas, photos[aIdx], ph.ops);
28828:       }catch(e){ /* mask pass must never break the frame */ }
28829:       return out;
28830:     };
28831:   }

28854:       var im=new Image();

28857:         var c=document.createElement('canvas');
28858:         c.width=Math.max(2,Math.round(im.naturalWidth*s)); c.height=Math.max(2,Math.round(im.naturalHeight*s));
28859:         c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);
28860:         try{ resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.85)); }catch(e){ resolve(dataUrl); }
28861:       };
28862:       im.onerror=function(){ resolve(dataUrl); };
28863:       im.src=dataUrl;
28864:     });

12436:   // ---- Automatic DENSE face-mesh correspondence (MediaPipe 468 pts) -----------------------
12437:   // Strides the full face mesh for ~156 evenly-spaced points so two facial portraits warp
12438:   // automatically (no manual plotting needed). Cached per photo; runs in the background.
12439:   const CF_MESH_IDX=(function(){ const a=[]; for(let i=0;i<468;i+=3) a.push(i); return a; })();
12440:   async function cfEnsureFaceMesh(photo){
12441:     if(!photo || !photo.dataUrl) return null;
12442:     if(photo._faceMesh) return photo._faceMesh;
12443:     if(photo._faceMeshTried && photo._faceMeshSrc===photo.dataUrl) return null;
12444:     photo._faceMeshTried=true; photo._faceMeshSrc=photo.dataUrl;
12445:     try{
12446:       const ok = window.initMediaPipeLocalML ? await window.initMediaPipeLocalML() : false;
12447:       if(!ok || !window.CaseFlowLocalML || !CaseFlowLocalML.faceLandmarker) return null;
12448:       const img=await loadImage(photo.dataUrl);
12449:       const res=CaseFlowLocalML.faceLandmarker.detect(img);
12450:       if(!res || !res.faceLandmarks || !res.faceLandmarks.length) return null;
12451:       const L=res.faceLandmarks[0];

12460:   // oralExpand: how far to extend the oral exclusion zone around face-mesh points
12461:   // (1.1 = tight, 1.6 = very wide). Driven by cfAssessPairRisk coarseWeight.
12462:   // ── Grid block-matching correspondences (Focus/intraoral) ──────────────────
12463:   // Two composited base canvases → sparse grid of TRUE point correspondences via
12464:   // coarse-to-fine NCC block matching. Unlike outline heuristics these vectors
12465:   // track real pixel structures, so warp motion follows actual tooth/gingiva
12466:   // features instead of pseudo-landmarks. Low-confidence and outlier vectors are
12467:   // rejected; on failure returns [] and the caller falls back to prior behaviour.
12468:   // window.CF_DISABLE_FLOW_LM=true disables (rollback).
12469:   function cfFlowGridPairs(baseA, baseB, w, h){
12470:     function gray(cv, gw){
12471:       const gh=Math.max(24,Math.round(gw*h/w));
12472:       const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=gw; c.height=gh;
12473:       const x=c.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
12474:       x.drawImage(cv,0,0,gw,gh);
12475:       const d=x.getImageData(0,0,gw,gh).data;
12476:       const g=new Float32Array(gw*gh);
12477:       for(let i=0;i<gw*gh;i++) g[i]=d[i*4]*0.299+d[i*4+1]*0.587+d[i*4+2]*0.114;
12478:       return {g:g,w:gw,h:gh};
12479:     }
12480:     function ncc(A,B,ax,ay,bx,by,r){
12481:       let sa=0,sb=0,saa=0,sbb=0,sab=0,n=0;
12482:       for(let dy=-r;dy<=r;dy++)for(let dx=-r;dx<=r;dx++){
12483:         const va=A.g[(ay+dy)*A.w+ax+dx], vb=B.g[(by+dy)*B.w+bx+dx];
12484:         sa+=va; sb+=vb; saa+=va*va; sbb+=vb*vb; sab+=va*vb; n++;
12485:       }
12486:       const ma=sa/n, mb=sb/n;
12487:       const va_=saa/n-ma*ma, vb_=sbb/n-mb*mb;
12488:       if(va_<18||vb_<18) return -2;                       // 無地ブロックは信頼不可
12489:       return (sab/n-ma*mb)/Math.sqrt(va_*vb_);
12490:     }
12491:     function bestMatch(A,B,ax,ay,cx,cy,search,r){
12492:       let bs=-2,bx=cx,by=cy;
12493:       const x0=Math.max(r,cx-search), x1=Math.min(B.w-1-r,cx+search);
12494:       const y0=Math.max(r,cy-search), y1=Math.min(B.h-1-r,cy+search);
12495:       for(let yy=y0;yy<=y1;yy++)for(let xx=x0;xx<=x1;xx++){
12496:         const s=ncc(A,B,ax,ay,xx,yy,r);
12497:         if(s>bs){ bs=s; bx=xx; by=yy; }
12498:       }
12499:       return {s:bs,x:bx,y:by};
12500:     }
12501:     const A1=gray(baseA,132), B1=gray(baseB,132);
12502:     const A2=gray(baseA,264), B2=gray(baseB,264);
12503:     const step=20, m=17, cand=[];
12504:     for(let gy=m;gy<A2.h-m;gy+=step)for(let gx=m;gx<A2.w-m;gx+=step){
12505:       // 粗探索(1/2解像度) → 精密化(基準解像度)
12506:       const c1=bestMatch(A1,B1,gx>>1,gy>>1,gx>>1,gy>>1,14,4);
12507:       if(c1.s<0.25) continue;
12508:       const c2=bestMatch(A2,B2,gx,gy,Math.min(A2.w-9,Math.max(8,c1.x*2)),Math.min(A2.h-9,Math.max(8,c1.y*2)),4,6);
12509:       if(c2.s<0.45) continue;
12510:       const vx=c2.x-gx, vy=c2.y-gy;
12511:       if(Math.hypot(vx,vy)>A2.w*0.17) continue;           // 非現実的な大変位は除外
12512:       cand.push({x:gx,y:gy,vx:vx,vy:vy,s:c2.s});
12513:     }
12514:     // 近傍中央値との乖離が大きい外れベクトルを除去（局所平滑性の担保）
12515:     function med(arr){ const a2=arr.slice().sort((p,q)=>p-q); return a2[a2.length>>1]; }
12516:     const keep=[];
12517:     for(const p of cand){
12518:       const nb=cand.filter(q=>Math.abs(q.x-p.x)<=step*2 && Math.abs(q.y-p.y)<=step*2);
12519:       if(nb.length<3) continue;
12520:       const mx=med(nb.map(q=>q.vx)), my=med(nb.map(q=>q.vy));
12521:       if(Math.hypot(p.vx-mx,p.vy-my)>7) continue;
12522:       keep.push(p);
12523:     }
12524:     if(keep.length<25) return [];                          // 全体として信頼できない場合は不使用
12525:     const sc=w/A2.w;
12526:     let out=keep.map(p=>({p1:{x:p.x*sc,y:p.y*sc}, p2:{x:(p.x+p.vx)*sc,y:(p.y+p.vy)*sc}}));
12527:     if(out.length>110){ const st2=Math.ceil(out.length/110); out=out.filter((_,i)=>i%st2===0); }
12528:     return out;
12529:   }

12531:   function collectMorphPairs(photoA, photoB, rectA, rectB, w, h, oralExpand, baseA, baseB){
12532:     const pairs = [];
12533:     const expand = oralExpand || 1.3;
12534:     // Canvas boundary: fixed, keeps the white frame stable.
12535:     const canvasBounds = [
12536:       [0,0],[w*.25,0],[w*.5,0],[w*.75,0],[w,0],
12537:       [w,h*.25],[w,h*.5],[w,h*.75],
12538:       [w,h],[w*.75,h],[w*.5,h],[w*.25,h],[0,h],
12539:       [0,h*.75],[0,h*.5],[0,h*.25]
12540:     ];
12541:     canvasBounds.forEach(([x,y])=>addPair(pairs,{x,y},{x,y},'canvas-boundary'));
12542: 
12543:     // Image rectangle boundaries: lets images with slightly different aspect ratios morph without tearing.
12544:     const edgeStops = [0,.25,.5,.75,1];
12545:     edgeStops.forEach(t=>{
12546:       addPair(pairs,{x:rectA.x+rectA.w*t,y:rectA.y},{x:rectB.x+rectB.w*t,y:rectB.y},'image-boundary');
12547:       addPair(pairs,{x:rectA.x+rectA.w*t,y:rectA.y+rectA.h},{x:rectB.x+rectB.w*t,y:rectB.y+rectB.h},'image-boundary');
12548:       addPair(pairs,{x:rectA.x,y:rectA.y+rectA.h*t},{x:rectB.x,y:rectB.y+rectB.h*t},'image-boundary');
12549:       addPair(pairs,{x:rectA.x+rectA.w,y:rectA.y+rectA.h*t},{x:rectB.x+rectB.w,y:rectB.y+rectB.h*t},'image-boundary');
12550:     });
12551: 
12552:     // True correspondences via grid block matching (intraoral: no face mesh).
12553:     // These are measured motion vectors between the two composited images, so
12554:     // when confident they outrank the heuristic auto-outline pseudo-landmarks.
12555:     let flowPairs=[];
12556:     const _noFace=!(photoA&&photoA._faceMesh)&&!(photoB&&photoB._faceMesh);
12557:     if(_noFace && baseA && baseB && !window.CF_DISABLE_FLOW_LM){
12558:       try{ flowPairs=cfFlowGridPairs(baseA,baseB,w,h); }catch(eF){ flowPairs=[]; }
12559:     }
12560:     const flowOK=flowPairs.length>=25;
12561:     // Server AI outlines (RE:Flex-style per-tooth masks) are the highest-trust
12562:     // auto source: exact crown silhouettes matched by FDI number.
12563:     const _srvRings=!!(photoA._serverOutline && photoB._serverOutline &&
12564:       (photoA._toothOutlines||[]).length>=2 && (photoB._toothOutlines||[]).length>=2);
12565: 
12566:     const la = ensureLM(photoA), lb = ensureLM(photoB);
12567:     let userCount = 0;
12568:     // A type counts as "pure auto" only if it still holds EXACTLY the points the
12569:     // auto-outline injected (untouched). The moment the user adds/moves/deletes a
12570:     // point the count changes → it's treated as manual and ALWAYS included, so
12571:     // manual edits are never dropped by the flow/server preference below.
12572:     function _pureAuto(p, lm, type){
12573:       return p._autoLM && p._autoLM[type] && p._autoLMN &&
12574:              (lm[type]||[]).length === p._autoLMN[type];
12575:     }
12576:     ['lip','gingiva','incisal'].forEach(type=>{
12577:       // When the flow grid or server rings are confident, the auto-injected
12578:       // outline lines (index-paired heuristics) only add noise — skip them, but
12579:       // NEVER skip a type the user has actually edited.
12580:       if((flowOK||_srvRings) && _pureAuto(photoA,la,type) && _pureAuto(photoB,lb,type)) return;
12581:       const A = la[type] || [], B = lb[type] || [];
12582:       const n = Math.min(A.length, B.length);
12583:       for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
12584:         addPair(pairs, normToRect(A[i], rectA), normToRect(B[i], rectB), type);
12585:         userCount++;
12586:       }
12587:     });
12588: 
12589:     // Per-tooth contour rings. Server rings are always included; local CV rings
12590:     // are kept only when they beat the flow grid in reliability (no confident
12591:     // flow, or a solid arch of ≥4 teeth detected on both sides). Unmatched
12592:     // teeth (missing/extracted) add no pairs and are carried by neighbours.
12593:     let _ringPolysA=null;
12594:     try{
12595:       if(typeof window.cfToothPairs==='function'){
12596:         const _ta=(photoA._toothOutlines||[]).length, _tb=(photoB._toothOutlines||[]).length;
12597:         if(_srvRings || !flowOK || (_ta>=4 && _tb>=4)){
12598:           const _tp=window.cfToothPairs(photoA,photoB)||[];
12599:           for(const q of _tp){ addPair(pairs, normToRect(q.a,rectA), normToRect(q.b,rectB), 'tooth'); userCount++; }
12600:           if(_srvRings && _tp.length){
12601:             _ringPolysA=(photoA._toothOutlines||[]).map(t=>(t.ring||[]).map(p=>normToRect(p,rectA)));
12602:           }
12603:         }
12604:       }
12605:     }catch(eT){}
12606: 
12607:     // Flow vectors complement the rings: rings own the crown interiors, flow
12608:     // handles gingiva/lips/background. Inside-ring flow points are dropped to
12609:     // avoid fighting the contour correspondence.
12610:     function _inPoly(pt,poly){
12611:       let c=false;
12612:       for(let i2=0,j2=poly.length-1;i2<poly.length;j2=i2++){
12613:         const a2=poly[i2], b2=poly[j2];
12614:         if(((a2.y>pt.y)!==(b2.y>pt.y)) && pt.x < (b2.x-a2.x)*(pt.y-a2.y)/((b2.y-a2.y)||1e-9)+a2.x) c=!c;
12615:       }
12616:       return c;
12617:     }
12618:     for(const q of flowPairs){
12619:       if(_ringPolysA && _ringPolysA.some(poly=>_inPoly(q.p1,poly))) continue;
12398:       mc.restore();
12399:       // Draw baseB, clip to mask, composite onto main ctx
12400:       var off2=document.createElement('canvas'); off2.width=w; off2.height=h;
12401:       var o2=off2.getContext('2d');
12402:       o2.drawImage(baseB,0,0);
12403:       o2.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';
12404:       o2.drawImage(msk,0,0);
12405:       ctx.save();
12406:       ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
12407:       ctx.drawImage(off2,0,0);
12408:       ctx.restore();
12409:     }catch(e2){}
12410:   }

23879:   // cfValidateExportDependencies — preflight check before export starts.
23880:   // Checks window.CaseFlowMorphEngine (not local scope) so cross-IIFE failures are caught
23881:   // before the export loop rather than exploding mid-render.
23882:   // Returns the validated engine object so callers can store it once.
23883:   function cfValidateExportDependencies(){
23884:     var missing=[];
23885:     var engine=window.CaseFlowMorphEngine;
23886:     if(!engine){
23887:       var err=new Error('CaseFlowMorphEngine が未初期化です。Morphing engineのIIFEが先にロードされているか確認してください。');
23888:       console.error('[CaseFlow Export] engine missing', err);
23889:       throw err;
23890:     }
23891:     ['fitContain','drawWarpedTriangle','delaunay','dedupePairs','collectMorphPairs',
23892:      'cfComputeDentalROI','cfAssessPairRisk','cfGetVariantDef','drawCaseflowGradientBg','ease'
23893:     ].forEach(function(name){
23894:       if(typeof engine[name]!=='function') missing.push(name);
23895:     });
23896:     if(typeof cfLoadImageForExport!=='function') missing.push('cfLoadImageForExport');
23897:     if(typeof cfMakeBaseCanvasForExport!=='function') missing.push('cfMakeBaseCanvasForExport');
23898:     if(missing.length>0){
23899:       var err2=new Error('Export dependency missing: '+missing.join(', '));
23900:       console.error('[CaseFlow Export] dependency error', err2, {engine:engine, missing:missing});
23901:       throw err2;
23902:     }
23903:     return engine;
23904:   }
23905:   window.cfValidateExportDependencies=cfValidateExportDependencies;

23907:   // computeFrameFingerprint — lightweight hash over 64×64 thumbnail for duplicate detection.
23908:   function computeFrameFingerprint(ctx, w, h){
23909:     var sW=64, sH=64;
23910:     var tmp=document.createElement('canvas'); tmp.width=sW; tmp.height=sH;
23911:     var tc=tmp.getContext('2d');
23912:     tc.drawImage(ctx.canvas, 0, 0, sW, sH);
23913:     var data=tc.getImageData(0,0,sW,sH).data;
23914:     var hash=0;
23915:     for(var i=0;i<data.length;i+=16){ hash=((hash<<5)-hash+data[i])|0; }
23916:     return hash;
23917:   }
